page.overview:
Who is Drixlitch Ovana?

is an elven toymaker in Uthodurn. As an NPC, he is played by Matthew Mercer.

Drixlitch is a tall elven gentleman, young to middle-aged with curly blond hair and a very long pointed nose. When encountered by Bells Hells, he wore ostentatious clothing and a tall top hat. He used a cane and walked with a slight limp.

Drixlitch repeatedly stressed that he was the majority owner of the business. Matt compared him to "a snide Willy Wonka". Chetney Pock O'Pea described Drixlitch as "a son of a bitch", and while Oltgar told the party he was "a unique individual who has a good mind for business," he was secretly thinking "this fucking son of a bitch," who had crushed not only his spirit but that of all the other toymakers in the shop.

According to Chetney, Oltgar Dradegon was a brilliant master craftsman and maker of fine wooden toys. Chetney had worked with him as his second in his shop in Uthodurn for years. When Drixlitch arrived, he was all about metal toys, and overnight, Oltgar sold part of the store to him, which Chetney viewed as a total betrayal. Eventually Chetney's hostility escalated to the point where he stabbed Drixlitch in the knee and Oltgar in the hand before fleeing. Drixlitch had to use a cane because of that injury, but he lied about its origin, saying he was wounded in a war.
